summary: Loader fetches and executes remote JS from unpinned Bitbucket URL
details: The package ships a loader (index.html and index.js) that fetches HTML from https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight, parses it, and re-injects every <script> element into the consuming page via document.body.appendChild. The source URL is pinned to a mutable branch (raw/main/...) with no integrity check, hash, or version pin, so whatever content the repository owner commits to that path at any later time will execute with full DOM privileges in the context of any page that includes this package. This is a remote-code fetch-and-execute dropper: the package itself contains no application logic and exists solely to load arbitrary author-controlled JavaScript from an external mutable location.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
